[Intro: fingerpicked twelve-string guitar, a soft cymbal]

[Verse 1: lead voice, the group echoes each line]

[Chorus: four-part harmony, full band]
Somewhere it's warm (somewhere it's warm)

Somewhere it's warm
And I'm here in the cold
